limitations.detail: An advisory's published_at is when the flaw was disclosed publicly, not when it was found or reported privately. Every gap on this site therefore measures how long a known, already-fixed flaw stayed quiet before users were told. It is not a measure of how fast maintainers fix things.
limitations.headline: Publication date is not discovery date.

limitations.detail: Labels currently come from: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API). A keyword fallback runs when no model provider is configured, and for any advisory the provider declines; it is cruder than the model pass, particularly for the 'other' class, which absorbs anything it cannot place. 8 of 454 rows still carry that fallback label and are marked preliminary where they appear. The 30-advisory hand-check has not been completed yet, so no agreement rate is reported.
limitations.headline: Attack-class labels come from a language model.

limitations.detail: Several are back-filled records where a PyPI release long predates the advisory system, producing gaps of a year or more. Every summary on this site is published twice, with and without outliers, so a reader can check that no finding depends on them.

limitations.headline: 25 gap values are statistical outliers and are kept, not dropped.

limitations.detail: 'No patched version' means the advisory listed no fixed release at collection time. It is not the same as a fix existing but not being found. These rows are excluded from every gap statistic and counted separately, because dropping them silently would flatter every median here.
limitations.headline: 60 rows have no patched version and so no gap.

limitations.detail: Packages were chosen for popularity and for covering four distinct roles in an AI stack, not at random. Per-package rates rest on as few as two advisories, so shares carry Wilson intervals and correlations across packages are reported with their p-values rather than as findings.
limitations.headline: 16 packages is a small sample.

limitations.detail: One advisory can affect several packages, for instance langchain and langchain-core. Each affected package becomes its own row, so counts on this site are advisory-package pairs unless a chart says otherwise.
limitations.headline: 454 rows cover 419 distinct advisories.
